lines.t: Shabbat Shalom… let the reverb breathe,
Light in the chords, truth underneath.
The Word fulfilled, the rhythm still,
In the law of love, we find His will.
In the vesture pure, The Spirit’s tone,
Law made flesh, yet grace made known.
He taught by walking, step in flame,
Every deed called us by name.
Bassline steady, drums restrained,
Heart in sync where peace remains.
He’s the Lord of the Sabbath…
The calm within the sound.
He’s the Law completed,
Where mercy gathers ’round.
Lift your eyes to heaven’s breath,
Rest, rejoice, and find your depth…
He’s the Lord, the Lord of rest.
O churches of men, hear the refrain,
Return to truth, break every chain.
If He obeyed what was divine,
Why drift away from holy time?
Echoes fall through synth and sky,
Still His call goes floating by.
He is the goal the Torah named,
The flame that cannot die.
Reverb folds into His name,
Faith drifts into the sky.
He’s the Lord of the Sabbath…
Through shadows, light is found.
He’s the Law completed,
Where love’s the higher sound.
Bassline fades, hearts confess,
Peace returns in gentleness…
Shabbat Shalom, in holiness.
